visual_differentiation_axes: cookbook recipe rail as the main command surface
right-side delivery clipboard instead of bottom order strip
semi-realistic animal silhouettes inside a warm cartoon ranch
mint meadow, barn red, sunflower yellow, and milk white palette signature
launcher icon centered on a realistic cow head with feed bowl and recipe tag
forbidden_visual_reuse: do not reuse Market Morning Farm crate-and-stall icon
do not reuse Pasture Parade Deluxe generic pen badge composition
do not use repeated top HUD pills plus bottom command strip
do not represent animals as simple round blobs
do not let decorative frames cover the ranch board or animal touch zones

ui_identity.layout_archetype: storybook ranch board with left cookbook recipe rail and right delivery clipboard
ui_identity.hud_composition: compact day clock and coin badge at upper left, reputation ribbon near upper center, freshness cooler meter as a small lower-right dock outside the animal pens
ui_identity.navigation_model: main menu opens into ranch board; recipe rail, order clipboard, upgrades sheet, pause sheet, and result sheet appear as anchored panels
ui_identity.palette_signature: mint meadow green, milk white panels, barn red section tabs, sunflower yellow reward highlights, small sky blue accents
ui_identity.material_language: painted wood tabs, paper recipe cards, soft raised buttons, stitched cloth badges, light shadows
ui_identity.typography_style: rounded friendly English UI text with clear hierarchy and large numeric counters
ui_identity.primary_ui_pack: skin_cartoon_light with custom ranch cookbook and clipboard drawable refinements

reserved_edges: top 12 percent for small HUD only
bottom 10 percent for cooler dock and toast area
playfield_safety.frame_overlay_policy: decorative wood and paper frames must sit in reserved side panels or dead space only and must never overlap animal bodies, drop targets, ingredient beds, or collection crates

unique_screen_motifs: cooler freshness gauge shaped like a milk bottle
forbidden_ui_elements: oversized modal cards covering active animals

icon_identity.subject: friendly realistic dairy cow head beside a wooden feed bowl with colorful snack pieces and a small recipe tag
icon_identity.silhouette: large cow head with visible muzzle, ears, small horns, and bowl crescent at the bottom
icon_identity.composition: cow head fills the upper center, feed bowl anchors the lower foreground, recipe tag overlaps one side without hiding the face
icon_identity.palette: milk white, black cow patches, mint green background, barn red tag, sunflower yellow snack highlights
icon_identity.background: rounded meadow badge with subtle grass base and light sky rim
icon_identity.game_specific_motif: recipe tag marked by simple feed icons to communicate snack mixing, not generic ranch care
forbidden_icon_reuse: no single animal silhouette without feed recipe motif
